test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Look at the hippo ______ about happily in the river.
solution:
The correct answer is** splashing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Splash:** (used about a liquid) to fall or to make liquid fall noisily or fly in drops onto a person or thing.

 
 
• **Example:** The children are **splashing** around in the shallow end of the swimming pool.
 
 
 
• **Splashing** is the **present participle or gerund **of splash. 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Crackle: **to make a series of short, sharp sounds.
 
• **Stammer: **to speak with difficulty, repeating sounds and pausing before saying things correctly.
 
• **Sputter: **make a series of soft explosive or spitting sounds..
